parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListHttpResponseHeaderModificationRules](~~2867483~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: ResponseHeaderModification
parameters.description: The response header modifications. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- add: adds a response header.
- del: deletes a response header.
- modify: modifies a response header.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The value type. Valid values:
- static: static pattern.
- dynamic: dynamic schema.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
